name: Nonrealizable Twenty-Six-Set Bouquet
definition: With bit order $(a_1,a_2,b_1,b_2,i,k)$ from least to most significant, take the family encoded by $\{0,1,2,3,4,5,8,10,12,16,20,24,28,32,33,34,35,48,49,50,51,52,54,56,57,60\}$.
properties: It is an ample conditional antimatroid of VC dimension three and Horn-renaming defect zero, but it has no affine-convex realization in any finite dimension. It nevertheless occurs as an exact section of a maximum class of rank four on eight coordinates.
